name: Ramp
description: Ramp is a spend management platform built around a fee-free corporate card, combining expense management, accounts payable automation, procurement, travel, and accounting sync with AI agents that auto-code transactions and flag policy exceptions.
best_for: Businesses wanting a no-fee corporate card bundled with AI-driven expense management and accounts payable automation, from a free plan up through enterprise procurement.
pros: Free plan available with unlimited physical and virtual cards, no annual fees, and no interest charges on the card
Zero processing fees on domestic ACH, check, and card AP payments
Native bidirectional sync with QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage Intacct (Workday and Oracle on higher tiers)
cons: AI-driven expense automation, NetSuite/Sage Intacct integrations, and a procurement add-on require the $15/user/month Plus plan plus a team-size-based platform fee
Enterprise tier requires annual billing and a custom sales quote
Ramp advertises cashback and card rewards but does not publish a single fixed cashback percentage on its pricing or card pages
features: Unlimited physical and virtual Visa cards with no personal credit checks or guarantees, usable in 200+ countries with local card issuance in 33 countries
Preset spend controls by vendor, category, and amount, plus cashback rewards with no annual fees or interest charges
Expense management with automatic receipt capture at purchase, AI-filled memos/categories, and submission via SMS, Slack, Teams, or the mobile app
Policy Agent that automatically reviews expenses and surfaces only exceptions
Accounts payable automation with OCR invoice-data extraction, AI agents for auto-coding, fraud detection, approval routing, and payment scheduling, plus 2-way/3-way PO matching
Zero processing fees on domestic ACH, check, and card AP payments
Procurement with AI contract parsing, dynamic approval routing, and auto-generated purchase orders
Travel booking with policy enforcement at time of booking and automatic rebooking when hotel rates drop by $50 or more
Native bidirectional accounting sync with QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Workday, and Oracle

pricing.starting_price: Free; $15/user/month (Plus) plus a team-size-based platform fee

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Corporate card with unlimited physical/virtual cards at no extra cost, expense management with SMS/Slack submission, invoice capture with OCR, basic accounting rules, QuickBooks Online and Xero integrations, and FDIC-insured treasury accounts with free wires.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Plus a platform fee based on team size. Save 20% with annual billing. Adds AI-driven automation (expense reviews, approval recommendations, auto-coding), NetSuite and Sage Intacct integrations, a procurement add-on, multi-entity support, and custom user roles.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom pricing via sales, billed annually. Adds Workday and Oracle integrations, white-glove support, implementation services, custom development, and locally funded global reimbursements.

alternatives.name: Brex
alternatives.description: A corporate card and spend management platform with a free entry tier and AI-driven expense automation.
alternatives.best_for: Startups and scaling companies wanting a free corporate card plus bill pay and travel in one platform.
strengths: AI-powered bill pay and GL coding

alternatives.name: BILL
alternatives.description: A financial operations platform combining a free corporate card (BILL Spend & Expense) with paid accounts payable and receivable automation.
alternatives.best_for: SMBs and accounting firms wanting free card-based spend management alongside subscription AP/AR automation.
strengths: BILL Spend & Expense has no per-user software fees
Deep two-way sync with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage Intacct
Procurement with purchase orders and 2-way matching on Corporate plan and above

alternatives.name: Expensify
alternatives.description: An expense management platform with receipt scanning, a commercial card, and in-app travel booking.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting simple receipt-driven expense reports, with discounted pricing when paired with the Expensify Card.
strengths: Up to 50% subscription discount for Expensify Card usage
